data.title: 莱伊 · 屋顶的风
data.description: 屋顶的风吹乱她的头发。她回头按住发丝，小声问你愿不愿意再陪她待一会儿。
data.action: 靠栏回望，伸手压住被风吹乱的头发
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Standing on a breezy industrial rooftop as twilight blazes across the horizon, Ray holds back windblown strands of honey hair, looking over her shoulder toward the viewer. The sky glows with vibrant peach and purple sunset hues, while towering radio antennae, satellite dishes, and sparkling city streetlights create an evocative open-air moment.
promptTokens: floppy bunny ears blowing in wind
